searchText: In the case of this one, it feels like if the author wants to keep the PR alive then they should apply or respond to the feedback. It isn't complex feedback, should take like 5 minutes to respond to. I thought we discussed this already and decided that withdrawn EIPs can be resurrected? Won't make it past review. 😛
